articles.title: Two fire incidents in Capital
articles.description: A fire broke out at a godown in Gali No. 2 of Khadda Colony in Swaroop Nagar, Jahangirpuri, northwest Delhi on Sunday, leaving six persons injured in an adjacent house, officials said. The fire was reported at around 11 am, following which multiple fire tenders were rushed to the spot. The Delhi Fire Services deployed [...]
